OAuth 应用和 GitHub App 有什么不同: How an OAuth app and a GitHub App differ
两种都是用你的 GitHub 账号登录、以你本人的身份读写，能看到的永远不会超过: Both sign in with your GitHub account and read and write as you; they never see more than you can see on GitHub yourself.
区别在于：第一次用要谁点头、权限由谁定、能不能逐项限制。凭据过期与否看各自应用的: The differences: who has to approve the first use, who decides the permissions, and whether they can be limited one by one. Whether the credential expires is a setting of each app, not of the sign-in method.
两种方式都一样的地方: What both methods have in common
应用本身不会在你没操作时替你做事：这一版只读取看板数据，不改 GitHub 上的: The app never acts on your behalf without you doing something: this version only reads board data and changes nothing on GitHub.
凭据只存在这台电脑的钥匙串里，只发给 GitHub；退出登录会把它删掉。: The credential is kept only in this computer's keychain and sent only to GitHub; signing out deletes it.
换登录方式只影响下一次登录，已经登录的账号照常使用，直到你退出。: Changing the sign-in method affects only the next sign-in; the account signed in now keeps working until you sign out.
这一版还没有内置的 GitHub App：填你自己或组织建的 GitHub Ap: This version has no built-in GitHub App: enter the Client ID of a GitHub App you or your organization created; that App must have "Enable Device Flow" ticked.
Client ID 不是秘密，不需要 Client secret。留空保存 =: A Client ID is not a secret, and no Client secret is needed. Saving it empty uses the built-in value.
这个 Client ID 不是 GitHub App 的（GitHub App: This Client ID is not a GitHub App's (those start with Iv, e.g. Iv23li…). It belongs to an OAuth app: to use it, switch the sign-in method back to "OAuth app".
这个 Client ID 是 GitHub App 的（以 Iv 开头）。要用它: This Client ID belongs to a GitHub App (it starts with Iv). To use it, switch the sign-in method to "GitHub App".
所填的 Client ID 和登录方式对不上，登录前请先改好。: The Client ID entered does not match the sign-in method; fix it before signing in.
用 GitHub App 时，权限由那个 App 登记时勾选的决定，登录时没法再: With a GitHub App, the permissions are whatever that App was registered with and cannot be narrowed at sign-in; what GitHub's authorization page lists is what counts. This version of the app only reads board data.
GitHub 授权页上会列出：repo（仓库读写，含代码与设置）、read:or: GitHub's authorization page will list: repo (read and write repositories, including code and settings), read:org, project — an OAuth app can only read private repositories by asking for all of repo. This version of the app only reads board data.
你在浏览器里点「授权」就行。只有组织开了「第三方应用访问限制」时，要组织管理员批: You click "Authorize" in the browser. Only when the organization has "third-party application access restrictions" on does an organization admin have to approve it once; until then its private repositories and Projects are not visible.
组织管理员（或仓库所有者）要先把这个 App 安装到组织、选好允许哪些仓库，然后: An organization admin (or the repository owner) first installs the App on the organization and picks the repositories it may access; then you click "Authorize".
本应用申请 repo（你能访问的全部仓库读写，包括代码和设置）、read:org: This app asks for repo (read and write every repository you can access, including code and settings), read:org and project. GitHub's OAuth permissions are coarse: reading the issues of a private repository requires all of repo.
由建 App 的人登记时逐项勾选，可以只勾 Issues、Pull reques: Ticked one by one by whoever registered the App; it can have just Issues, Pull requests and Projects with no code access — but what it has depends on that App's settings, cannot be narrowed at sign-in, and is what GitHub's authorization page lists.
你本人能看到的，在上面申请的范围内。: What you can see yourself, within the permissions above.
三者都满足才行：你本人能看到的、App 登记的权限允许的、App 被安装到的仓库: Only what meets all three: you can see it yourself, the App's registered permissions allow it, and the App is installed on that repository.
看应用的设置：开了「令牌过期」的会过期（本应用会自动续期）；没开的不过期，直到你: Depends on the app's settings: with "token expiration" on it expires (this app renews it automatically); with it off it does not expire until you revoke it.
看 App 的设置：默认开着「令牌过期」（8 小时，本应用会自动续期），建 Ap: Depends on the App's settings: "token expiration" is on by default (8 hours; this app renews it automatically); whoever created the App can turn it off, and then it does not expire.
拿到的人能以你的名义做 repo 权限范围内的一切（包括推代码）。令牌会过期的，: Whoever has it can do anything within the repo permission in your name (including pushing code). An expiring token alone works only until it expires; together with the renewal credential, or if the token does not expire, it works until you revoke it.
拿到的人能做的不超过那个 App 登记的权限。过期规则同左：单拿到会过期的令牌只: Whoever has it can do no more than the App's registered permissions. Expiry works as on the left: an expiring token alone works only until it expires; together with the renewal credential, or if the token does not expire, it works until you revoke it.

大多数情况用默认的 OAuth 应用：不用等组织管理员安装，登录就能用。: In most cases use the default OAuth app: no waiting for an organization admin to install anything, it works as soon as you sign in.

顶栏右侧的数，按下表的顺序、名称和颜色显示；点数字只看这些条目。: The counts on the right of the top bar, in the order, names and colours below; click a count to list only those items.
预览（按当前来源实时计数）: Preview (live counts over the current sources)
一个数都不显示：顶栏不显示计数: No count is shown: the top bar shows no counts
保存的顶栏计数读不出，现在显示的是默认的几个数；在这里改动一次就会重新保存。: The saved view-bar counts could not be read; the default counts are shown. Any change here saves them again.
顶栏右侧的每个数各对应上面一行，按这里的顺序、名称和颜色显示；数的是当前勾选来源: Each count on the right of the top bar is one row above, in this order, name and colour; it counts the items of the ticked sources, whatever the search box says. Clicking a count puts that row's condition in the search box to list only those; clicking again goes back to the previous search.
「跟随流程标签」的行按上面「流程标签」里的标签名直接数：跟随「等人处理的标签」的: A "follows a flow label" row counts by the label name under "Flow labels" above: a row following the waiting-for-human label counts open and closed items (the rule reminders use), the others only open ones; it follows the label when it is renamed. A condition of your own is written like the search box (e.g. {a}, {b}).
一个数都不留 = 顶栏不显示计数。系统通知和 Dock 角标仍按「等人处理的标签: No rows left = the top bar shows no counts. System notifications and the Dock badge still count the waiting-for-human label, whatever is set here.
打开后连已关闭、已合并的条目一起显示。只限已读到的条目：仓库来源读全部开着的、近:
When on, closed and merged items are shown too — only items already read: a repository source reads every open item, items updated in the last 14 days and closed items carrying a "waiting for human" label; a Project source reads every item on its board.
The board, the table, the dependency graph and each lit top-bar number remember it separately.
设置里「流程标签」的「等人处理」「交给 agent」两个标签名不能为空: The "Waiting for human" and "Hand to agent" label names under "Flow labels" in Settings cannot be empty
点「改」后按下新键，只在这台电脑生效。: Click "Change", then press the new key; it applies on this computer only.
哪些键固定、单个键何时生效: Which keys are fixed, and when a single key works
一个操作改成一个键，原来的键随之不再起作用。Esc、↩、方向键、{first}: Changing an action to a key stops its old keys from working. Esc, ↩, the arrow keys, {first} … {last}, {close} and the zoom keys are fixed and cannot be changed. A single key without {mod} works only while the cursor is not in a text box.
固定的键，不能改: A fixed key; it cannot be changed
顶栏「稍后处理」，标签下拉里排在等人处理之后；留空 = 两样都不做: The "Later" count, and right after the waiting-for-human label in label pickers; empty = neither
